talking_points.heading: Fabric is a rebundling
bullets: Power BI, Synapse, Data Factory, and Azure Data Explorer with OneLake as storage layer
1.5 years post GA, compute remains fragmented, storage remains locked, governance immature

talking_points.heading: Lock-in
bullets: OneLake is vendor-locked storage requiring Fabric compute
3X cost tax for external engine access
Customers wanting Open Lakehouse should use open storage

talking_points.heading: Expensive
bullets: Too big = wasted money, too small = throttled workloads
Pay-go Spark still requires active Fabric capacity

fabric.description: Power BI direct query to OneLake
Build chatbots (now part of Copilot Studio)
Managed Delta Lake tables in OneLake
Limited to Spark, SQL, Power BI

databricks.text: Unity Catalog provides unified governance for all Data & AI assets across clouds
